title: Vice President to visit Odisha on November 16, 2026
body_text: The Vice-President of India, Shri C. P. Radhakrishnan, will visit Odisha on November 16, 2026. The Vice-President will grace the Orientation Programme for Members of the Odisha Legislative Assembly in Bhubaneswar. He will also inaugurate the Iconic Tower(Academic Building) of Sri Sri University in Cuttack during the visit. *** PR/ASM/VM
